column2: Target product attributes, attribute sets and groups of the two rebuilt M2 instances: EL OS (B2B) and B2C (JL + SG), and how every one of the 377 attributes of today maps to them. Third layer after the PIM sheet: PIM fields (Product Data Model) -> M2 attributes (this sheet). Values checked against the prod dump (2026-10-15) and the code; drafted by Claude 2026-11-12.

EL OS: 63 EAV attributes in 1 attribute set. B2C: 79 attributes in 3 sets (Product, Mattress, Service). Today: 377 attributes, 92 attribute sets. PIM product_type keeps today's 90 attribute sets 1:1 (Data Team templates, C&C rules).

1) Listing filters come from the Search Service; facet values stay select / multiselect in M2 (fallback), not filterable. 2) Display-only specs = one JSON attribute. 3) PIM keeps one template per product type (= today's attribute sets); M2 uses the product_type attribute and minimal sets; the attribute set id -> Shipment Service C&C mapping is preserved via legacy_attribute_set_id (S-14). 5) No configurable products in either instance. 6) One dimension standard in PIM for both M2 (S-07). 7) Model covers B2B and B2C. 8) FE keeps what exists today (JL / SG Packaging Dimensions tab); Fusedship rating via the Shipment Service (S-01). 9) Dropship status rule is kept and moves with DS stock to the Shipment Service (S-03). 10) Every attribute marked for removal was checked against business logic (tab Logic Check).

OOTB attribute first, then the existing code when the meaning is unchanged (less rework for POS, feeds and migration), a new code only when the meaning changes (product_type, family_code, merged lists). Repeating groups are JSON, not numbered attributes. PIM is the master: these attributes are read-only in M2 admin. Not carried: constants, flags never set, config stored per product, integration state. B2B has one website, so every attribute is global there; B2C scopes are in column Scope B2C (scopable PIM fields -> store view, status -> website).

Attributes: one row per target attribute (rows joined with / are several OOTB attributes), then the non-EAV data (stock item, rules, relations, other systems). Attribute Sets / Attribute Groups: set and group layout per instance. Product Types: today's attribute sets -> product_type -> target set. Simplifications: S-01..S-21 with prod evidence. Migration Map: every current attribute -> target per instance. Logic Check: every attribute removed or moved, with the code that reads it and the decision.

The PIM is seeded by a one-off patch from the current M2: product_type per SKU from attribute_set_id (tab Product Types, column A = legacy_attribute_set_id), plus the carton JSON-only items (S-01). The same map converts the Shipment Service C&C / delivery lists. C&C counts in Product Types are from the staging DB; the conversion must read prod.
